## What's Changed

* build(deps-dev): bump webpack-cli from 7.2.2 to 7.2.3 in /web/app by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15633
* build(deps-dev): bump webpack from 5.110.0 to 5.110.3 in /web/app by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15634
* build(deps-dev): bump jest-environment-jsdom from 30.4.1 to 30.5.1 in /web/app by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15635
* build(deps): bump github.com/go-openapi/spec from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15638
* build(deps): bump github.com/bombsimon/logrusr/v4 from 4.1.0 to 4.2.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15639
* build(deps): bump github.com/prometheus/client_model from 0.6.2 to 0.6.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15640

* build(deps): bump github.com/sirupsen/logrus from 1.10.1 to 1.10.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15642
* build(deps): bump aho-corasick from 1.1.4 to 1.1.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15643
* build(deps): bump rustls-webpki from 0.103.14 to 0.103.15 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15644
* build(deps): bump log from 0.4.33 to 0.4.34 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15646
* build(deps): bump syn from 3.0.3 to 3.0.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15647
* build(deps): bump chacha20 from 0.10.1 to 0.10.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15645

* build(deps): bump golang.org/x/tools from 0.49.0 to 0.50.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15654
* chore: add @adleong to emeriti add @raykroeker to maintainers by @raykroeker in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15650
* chore(deps): upgrade proxy-init to v2.4.10 and cni-plugin to v1.7.0 by @anthoturc in https://github.com/linkerd/linkerd2/pull/15663
